role: Fallback renderer registered for Entity.class in RenderManager: draws the entity's bounding box as an offset wireframe (renderOffsetAABB). Reached only when an entity class has no registered renderer.
scope_reason: Every entity class this game can spawn has its own renderer in RenderManager's entityRenderMap, so the fallback is never reached; and its output is a debug wireframe, not game content.

members.name: doRender
members.note: unreachable fallback: RenderManager.java registers a renderer for every spawnable entity class; the box draw itself is Render.renderOffsetAABB

notes: Registered at RenderManager.java:158 (entityRenderMap.put(Entity.class, new RenderEntity())). If the native engine ever grows a fallback draw, it would be a wireframe in raster_overlay.c's line style.
